'''Synth-steel''' was a class of [[Black/Legends|black-colored]] steel. The [[Imperial Station Bravo|fortress]] of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] had multiple synth-steel towers, atop which were [[Gun emplacement (Tatooine)|gun emplacements]].<ref name="Ghostling" />
